changes.before: Modify several files atomically; creates a reviewed proposal, never promotes automatically. Accepts ordinary or Agent feedback input.
changes.after: Receive file changes from another node. Creates one revision for the batch; publish it in Skill files when ready.

changes.before: Supply a source to discover skills.
changes.after: Set Source to browse skills, or use a saved reference.
Scans Source and lists available skills and revisions. Reads and imports files; never runs a Skill or changes the selected revision.

changes.before: What the connected Agent should change in the selected skill.
changes.after: Legacy saved feedback request. New edits use Operation or the Skill files editor.

changes.before: Type in the dropdown to filter discovered revisions.
changes.after: The exact file version to use. Choose a discovered revision; refreshing never selects a newer version.

changes.before: Repository URL or allowed local folder. Leave empty for an existing pinned registry reference.
changes.after: Public HTTPS GitHub/GitLab repository URL, or a local folder allowed by the host source service. Leave empty to use a saved registry reference.

changes.before: Read an immutable skill or propose a traceable, atomic multi-file revision.
changes.after: Use and edit versioned skill files.
